# Aurum Bites

> Aurum Bites sources and distributes high-quality dairy products for businesses and consumers.

The site includes an e-commerce shop with filtered product browsing and direct contact information.

## Main

- [Shop](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/shop): Product catalog with filtering by category and brand, cart, and checkout.
- [Pasta Zara](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/shop?brand=pasta-zara): Pasta Zara branded products filtered within the main shop catalog.
- [President](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/shop?brand=president): President branded products filtered within the main shop catalog.
- [Cremeitalia](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/shop?brand=crme-italia): Crème Italia branded products filtered within the main shop catalog.
- [View All](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/shop?collection=cream,butter&brand=all&type=all): Cream and butter product collection filtered within the main shop.
- [View All](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/shop?collection=cheese--slice&brand=all&type=all): Cheese and slice product collection filtered within the main shop.
- [View All](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/shop?collection=dry&brand=all&type=all): Dry goods product collection filtered within the main shop.

## Optional

- [Enquire](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/contact): Contact information, phone numbers, email, and physical address.
